title: Fork pull requests never run on a self-hosted runner in adopting repositories
body:
Source: operator-forwarded weekly code review 2026-11-19 (800 PRs since 2026-11-12, deep pass on ship gate, lane write guard, CI). Evidence: .github/workflows/project-ci.yml:58 applies the caller's runner input (possibly a self-hosted label) to every job including Plan and the aggregate Check, so a fork PR in an adopting repository would run on a self-hosted machine.
Files: .github/workflows/project-ci.yml, test/ci/project-ci-workflow.test.ts
Outcome: a pull_request from a fork never runs on a self-hosted runner: the reusable workflow falls back to a GitHub-hosted runner when the head repository differs from the base.
Proof: `node --test test/ci/project-ci-workflow.test.ts: pass` asserting the fork condition on every job's runs-on.
